examples.text: nagā samuddā saritā vasun'dharā, disā catasso vidisā adho divā, sabbe aniccā tibhavā upaddutā, kuhiṃ gato citta sukhaṃ ramissasi.

kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagara-upamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā. yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.
tam'anugacchanto passeyya purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.

35406.commentary: (SNa) yasmā majjhimadese nagarassa uddhāpapākār'ādīni thirāni vā hontu dubbalāni vā, sabbaso vā pana mā hontu, corānaṃ āsaṅkā na hoti. tasmā taṃ aggahetvā paccantimaṃ nagaran'ti āha.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ, tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
tena kho pana samayena sunidhavassakārā magadhamah'āmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi nagarakamhā niyyāsi mahaccā rāj'ānubhāvena. yena ārāmo tena pāyāsi.

35408.meaning1: talk about towns; discussion about cities

35411.meaning1: city raider; town looter; town plunderer

35413.meaning1: town gates; entrance to the city

atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto anattamano ahosi, kathañ'hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpad'atthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī'ti!

35415.commentary: (VINa) gāmena pūjitaṃ gāmassa vā pūjitan'ti gāmapūjitaṃ. es'eva nayo sesapadesu'pi.

35417.meaning2: restraint in a town; restriction in a town

35422.commentary: (APt) dāsim'pi hi vaṇṇasampannaṃ keci sāmikā dhanalobhena gaṇikaṃ karonti. nagaraṃ sobhetī'ti nagarasobhinī.

examples.text: kurudhammo nāma pañcasīlāni, tāni bodhisatto parisuddhāni katvā rakkhi. yathā ca bodhisatto, evam'assa mātā aggamah'esī kaniṭṭhabhātā uparājā purohito brāhmaṇo rajjugāhako amacco sārathi seṭṭhi doṇamāpako mah'āmatto dovāriko nagarasobhinī vaṇṇadāsī'ti

35423.meaning1: lord of the town; mayor; town chief

35424.meaning1: lord of the town; mayor; town chief

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena nagaravindaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ gāmo tadavasari.
assosuṃ kho nagaravindeyyā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ nagaravindaṃ anuppatto.

nagara + vinda + eyya + ka
nagaravindeyya + ka

35431.meaning1: facing the town; directed towards the town

examples.text: paṇḍito uppāditadhanañ'ca, ābhatadhanañ'ca sabbaṃ tassā mātāpitūnaṃ datvā samassāsetvā sasure āpucchitvā taṃ ādāya nagar'ābhimukho agamāsi.
sā yattha vā tattha vā gacchatu, na me muccissatī'ti veravegasamussāhitamānasā nagar'ābhimukhī pakkhandi.

35432.commentary: (DNa) nagar'ūpakārikāsū'ti ettha upakārikā'ti paresaṃ ārohanivāraṇ'atthaṃ samantā nagaraṃ pākārassa adhobhāge katasudhākammaṃ vuccati. idha pana tāhi upakārikāhi yuttāni nagarān'eva nagar'ūpakārikāyo'ti adhippetāni.

examples.text: evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagar'ūpakārikāsu dīghāsi'vudhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
sah'ācaritena chavo sigālo, na kotthuko sīhasamo kadāci, naggo musāvādī gaṇassa satthā, saṅkassar'ācāro na sataṃ sarikkho'ti.
acelako nāma yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno naggo.
na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.

atirekaṃ kho pan'imassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ yo'haṃ puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ.
imehi kho me, gahapati, tiṃsamattehi vassehi pabbajitassa n'atthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato phāsuvihāro, aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvaḷanipphoṭanāya cā'ti

35442.commentary: (DNa) na'pi nīyanti naṅgalā'ti naṅgalāni'pi tattha kasikammaṃ karissāmā'ti na khettaṃ nīyanti.

35445.commentary: (ANa) naṅgalamukhānī'ti mātikāmukhāni. tāni hi naṅgalasarikkhakattā naṅgalehi ca khatattā naṅgalamukhānī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadī pabbateyyā dūraṅ'gamā sīghasotā hārahārinī. tassā puriso ubhato naṅgalamukhāni vivareyya.
tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.
seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ rūpiyaṃ, evam'assa dantā honti. seyyathā'pi nāma mahatī naṅgalasīsā, evam'assa soṇḍo hoti.
seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ rūpiyaṃ, evam'assa dantā honti. seyyathā'pi nāma mahatī naṅgal'īsā, evam'assa soṇḍo hoti.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato… dantehi'pi kammaṃ karoti, naṅguṭṭhena'pi kammaṃ karoti, rakkhat'eva soṇḍaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso alagadd'atthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya.

tatiyam'pi kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe sacc'ālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti. idha bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

35497.meaning1: head of a dance troupe; leader of a group of performers

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
aññataro naṭapubbako bhikkhu evam'āha, sabbo'yaṃ maññe saṅgho sītīkato'ti.

35499.commentary: (DNt) naṭasamūhena pana janasamūhe karaṇavasena naṭasamajjan'ti vuttaṃ, sārasamāse pekkhā mahan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: mahāsatto pana niraye nibbattakāle tava khaṇamattam'pi hāso vā somanassaṃ vā n'atthī'ti nirayabhayaṃ āvajjetvā niccalo'va ahosi, taṃ na olokesi. evaṃ naṭasamajjena'pi ekasaṃvaccharaṃ antar'antarā vīmaṃsantā'pi'ssa n'eva antaraṃ passiṃsu.
